value.answer: Cooler tomorrow in Denver. Expect partly sunny skies and a high around 65°F, about 15 degrees below today. Clouds build through the day with a 30% chance of rain after 3 p.m., mostly in the evening. Lows Tuesday night drop into the 30s and low 40s, with a breeze around 6 to 10 mph and gusts up to 17.
